newsitem.title: NORWAY: Orkla increases shares in Storebrand.
newsitem.headline: Orkla increases shares in Storebrand.

text.p: Norwegian conglomerate Orkla has increased its shareholding in insurance group Storebrand to 9.65 percent from 9.09 percent, according to a listing of shareholders supplied by the Norwegian Registry of Securities (VPS).
On Wednesday's listing, Orkla held 34,243,213 ordinary shares, corresponding to 12.37 percent of the ordinary share capital.
Friday's VPS listing shows Orkla owning 36,348,954 ordinary shares, or 13.13 prosent. This corresponds to 9.65 percent of total Storebrand stock, including preference shares.
An Orkla spokeswoman declined to comment on what the company does with its share portfolio.
Orkla has said it is sceptical of plans by Storebrand and Christiania Bank og Kreditkasse to merge.
